items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: they had a girl and her name was Gertie Waters

ctx.x: So, he says, well, Mr. Butler, how would you like to have the band, make a band up, upstairs and we'll call it The Rockheads Rendezvous and I said I'd be delighted/

So, then we had another -- they had a girl and her name was Gertie Waters. She could read all the music, couldn't do some of the jazz, but she would play those chords for you. And Kurzie was a beautiful saxophone player. Beautiful fellow.

Then we had a fellow, his name was Freddie Blackburn. his father was West Indian, his mother French Now, Freddie was a Canadian, he was Canadian, but -- this poor boy, there was an awful calamity in his life.
